title: Studio Ponytail Portrait
prompt: A minimalist studio portrait of an original young woman against a pale gray-white seamless backdrop, framed vertically and cropped from mid-torso up. Her long, straight black hair is swept back from her face and pulled to one side in a low, sleek ponytail that falls past her shoulder and down her chest, with loose strands framing her temples. She wears a fitted black strapless top, with bare shoulders and arms. Natural makeup with soft pink-brown lips, and a calm, direct gaze toward the camera. Soft, even studio lighting with gentle shadows along the jaw and collarbone, a monochrome palette of soft grays, white, and deep black, warm-neutral skin tones. The long ponytail creates a strong diagonal line down the right side of the frame. Poised, editorial, and graphic, in the style of a hair care or minimalist fashion lookbook.
workingNotes:
- Strong choice for hair care campaigns or lookbooks.
- The diagonal ponytail is the key compositional element.
tryThis: Try this: Emphasize the diagonal ponytail.
